SL0S277 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT BY ANDBETWEEN BROADWAYROOSEVELTPLAZA,LLC AND BROADWAYROOSEVELTJUNCTIONLLC Dated: as of February 18, 2025 QUEENS BL0CK:1486 TAX LOTS: 13 and 36 RECORD AND RETURN TO: GOLDMANHARRISLLC 475PARKAVENUESOUTH,28THFLO0R NEWYORK,NEWYORK10016 ATTENTION:HOWARDGOLDMAN,ESQ.

THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made as of the 18th day of February,2025 by and between BROADWAY ROOSEVELT PLAZA, LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Parcel A Owner") located at 466 Albany Avenue, #8, Brooklyn, New York 11213 and BROADWAY ROOSEVELT JUNCTION LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Parcel B Owner") located at 466 Albany Avenue, #8, Brooklyn, New York 11213 and (Parcel A Owner and Parcel B Owner, collectively, the “Parties", when referred to in the singular, a “Party"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,ParcelA Owner is the owner infee title of certain land in the Borough of Queens, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 75-01 Broadway, Elmhurst, New York, comprising Tax Lot 13 in Block 1486 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the“Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Parcel A Land" inclusive of any improvements, buildings, or structures), together with any future enlargement, or replacements thereof permitted the Parcel A Land and the Parcel A Building being herein collectively called the “Parcel A Premises"); WHEREAS,Parcel B Owner is the owner in fee of certain land in the Borough of Queens, City and State of New York,generally known by the street address 40-16 76th Street, Elmhurst, on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Parcel B Land,” inclusive of any improvements, buildings, or structures being herein called “Parcel B Building"), together with any future enlargement, or replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Parcel B Building,”' and the Parcel B Land and the Parcel B Building being herein collectively called the “Parcel B Premises"); WHEREAS,the Parties have executed a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions(the "Declaration"), concurrently with this Agreement, in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot’ in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as defined herein). WHEREAS, all“parties in interest" (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Zoning Lot, as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Sutton Land Title Agency, LLC to be recorded simultaneously herewith,have either executed the Declaration or waived their right to do so, and have either executed this Agreement or subordinated their respective interests in the Zoning Lot to this Agreement. WHEREAS, immediately after recording this Agreement, the Parties intend to finalize the tax lot reapportionment of their respective lots by subdividing a 4,0o0 square foot portion of the Parcel A Land fronting on 76th Street and combining it with Parcel B Land (as reapportioned, the "DevelopmentSite").
